subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: per-gateway custom headers for gateways behind authenticating proxies

question: Should Android accept arbitrary operator-defined per-gateway credential headers on gateway WebSocket upgrades, matching the merged iOS direction, and what owner/security conditions must be met before landing?
rationale: This is a credential-bearing pre-Gateway-auth transport boundary with new mobile secure storage, UI, redaction, clearing, TLS, and gateway-only attachment rules, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/security contract.

options.title: Approve Android parity after security review
options.body: Proceed with the open Android PR once owner/security review signs off on storage, sanitizer, TLS-only, reset, diagnostics, and non-gateway isolation behavior.

options.title: Narrow to typed proxy auth
options.body: Ask for a smaller Basic/Bearer or fixed-header contract if arbitrary custom headers are too broad for mobile clients.

options.title: Defer mobile proxy credentials
options.body: Keep native proxy headers unsupported until maintainers define a cross-platform mobile transport-auth design.

recommendation.title: Approve Android parity after security review
recommendation.body: Proceed with the open Android PR once owner/security review signs off on storage, sanitizer, TLS-only, reset, diagnostics, and non-gateway isolation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the current feature request and both platform implementation threads, and is the assignee on the live issue.
